answer: The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money: sparingly and against verified performance, so Sybil inflation is filtered out before it can compound into a decisive advantage. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. The defense holds because trust accrues slowly and is lost fast, so a farm that ever submits a copied answer destroys the value of that identity. Consider a cipher as the anchor of the cost. A vault stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a river...
